rule: A family mapping is invalid if it changes the meaning of a canonical field or moves external verification/authority inside the morphology to make the mapping fit.

families.Theta: weights, optimizer state, recurrent/working state where persistent at the registered timescale
families.K: forward inference, sampling, model-based internal computation/action proposal
families.Gamma: identity for fixed architecture; otherwise NAS/neuroevolution/growth/pruning/module restructuring
families.kappa: map network inputs/outputs/actions and update receipts into the registered task/evidence semantics
families.V_external: held-out/task-specific evaluator; formal/execution verifier where available
families.development_protocol_D: pretraining/fine-tuning/meta-training streams, legal data/tools, update permissions and reset semantics

families.Theta: facts, rules, preferences, agenda/activation and persistent symbolic state
families.K: match, unify, retrieve, propose, select, apply, explicit search
families.U: rule induction, chunking, utility update, truth-maintenance/revision
families.kappa: map symbolic states/actions/results into the registered task/evidence semantics
families.C_external: protected inputs, authority, metering and commitment boundary
families.development_protocol_D: initial rule/fact base, teaching streams, allowed chunking/induction/revision, reset semantics

families.F: factor graph, Bayesian network or probabilistic-program structure
families.K: inference, sampling, prediction, expected-utility planning/experiment selection
families.U: Bayesian conditioning, parameter learning, approximate-posterior update
families.kappa: map predictive/action/evidence distributions into the registered task/evidence semantics
families.V_external: external prediction/decision/evidence contract; posterior probability itself is not automatically verification
families.C_external: data-access, experiment authority and evidence/admission boundary
families.development_protocol_D: prior/model initialization, legal observations/interventions, inference/update algorithm and structure-learning permissions

families.Theta: current library, grammar/search priors, partial programs and reusable abstractions
families.K: enumeration, synthesis, program execution, retrieval and checking
families.U: library abstraction/admission, search-prior update, failure constraints
families.kappa: map program behavior/checker receipts into the registered task/evidence semantics
families.development_protocol_D: initial language/library, task stream, legal abstraction/mining/update rules, reset/continuation

families.F: genotype/phenotype encoding, population/archive organization and variation graph
families.Theta: population, archive, fitness/evidence and strategy parameters
families.Gamma: variation-kernel, encoding, search-operator or architecture-family evolution
families.kappa: map candidate phenotype/evaluation receipts into the registered task/evidence semantics
families.development_protocol_D: initial population/encoding, variation operators, evaluator access, archive/reset semantics

families.F: warranted epistemic field plus cognitive assets, provenance/dependency and explicit organization
families.Theta: facts, methods, applicability/control state, failures, self-model, lifecycle/authority metadata
families.K: retrieval, search, composition, controller/executive and declared donor/tool invocation
families.U: externally verified admission, revision/revocation, failure learning, applicability/value update, consolidation/retirement
families.Gamma: governed proposal/adoption of representation, operator, control or morphology changes
families.kappa: Check/Authority/Meter/Commit and task/domain contracts connect internal proposals to externally admissible results
families.development_protocol_D: persistent lineage, legal evidence streams, donor access, authority limits, adoption/rollback/reset rules
